name: Reminiscence Fingerhitch
description: Choose two stones of equal weight by feel so that the pair will fly together.

name: Royal Singing
description: Open the whirl with both stones riding the pouch side by side through the first turn.

name: Thunderclap Cordleft
description: Let both stones go at the crown of the circle so that they leave as a matched pair.

name: Peal Cradle
description: Send one pulse through both stones so that they fly a hand's breadth apart and land together.

name: Wristhitch Troth
description: Skip the first stone off the ground into an ankle and follow with the second at the head.

name: Squall Releasecord
description: Cross the two cords before the chest and turn a thrown blade aside along the crossing.

name: Radiance Orbit
description: Hammer a plate with the first stone and slip the second into the dent it leaves behind.

name: Choral Flingaway
description: Throw one stone high and one at the feet in running pairs so a single guard cannot hold both.

name: Squallorbit
description: Drive two hawk-matched stones onto a foe's helm in the same heartbeat for a crushing blow.

name: Vigor Pelt
description: Wind the whole manual's forms into one cast that sends a hawk pair down onto a single foe.

name: Peal Slingstone
description: Set the two tracks on the ground in the mind before either cord begins to turn.

name: Inferno Slung
description: Whirl the first cord in a high circle above the head that will serve as the sky track.

name: Grand Pouch
description: Run the second cord in a low circle beside the knee as the river track beneath.

name: Hospitable Leadshot
description: Swap the cords between the hands in mid-turn so each arm trains both tracks.

name: Magnificent Slingstone
description: Hold the low stone a beat longer so it reaches the foe just after the high one.

name: Thrallcradle
description: Curve the low cord round a foe's ankle in a river's bend and haul him from his feet.

name: Cradlebanner
description: Throw the high stone with a rising pulse so that it clears a ridge and drops on the other side.

name: Cradlecrown
description: Alternate throws from the two tracks so that every other stone comes from a different angle.

name: Subtle Cordright
description: Lay the low cord across a path and loose stones from the high track at whoever trips on it.

name: Thunderclap Releasecord
description: Bring both tracks together on the foe's guard so that the two stones strike the same hole.

name: Famed Slingtether
description: Merge the two tracks into a single circle at the instant of release and strike with both stones as one.

name: Bountiful Pouch
description: Gather the twin cords at the belt in one motion before the court of two hands is opened.

name: Vigor Slingtether
description: Slip a loop over each hand's middle finger and press each tail beneath its thumb.

name: Majestic Flingaway
description: Set both cords whirling at once in matched circles that never touch above the shoulders.

name: Bedrock Cordleft
description: Step in matched paces so that each foot lands as its cord comes round.

name: Pulsar Stonepelt
description: Send the right stone low along the ground and the left high at the same moment.

name: Bedrock Stonepelt
description: Lash both cords at a foe's sword wrist from two sides and sting the grip loose.

name: Undefiled Cradle
description: Cross the cords into an X to catch a cutting blade and slide it harmlessly off.

name: Thunderclap Slung
description: Throw a pulse-driven pair a half-beat apart so that the second strikes the first one's dent.

name: Venom Cordright
description: Cross both cords over a blade and haul it from the hand and across the court's floor.

name: Tempestuous Fingerhitch
description: Orbit both pouches around the body and send stones in a wheel at every foe nearby.

name: Vigor Singing
description: Meet both cords on the foe's chest from left and right so the stones strike the same ribs.

name: Majestic Pelt
description: Pass all of the court's forms into a last cast of two cords that settles a duel in one blow.

name: Pouchbenison
description: From a high perch fix the eye on one head among many and hold it there.

name: Dauntless Fingerhitch
description: Circle the pouch in slow wide turns like a hawk waiting on the thermal above its prey.

name: Squall Wristhitch
description: Release at the top of the circle so that the stone stoops steeply onto the chosen head.

name: Noble Leadshot
description: Add a downward pulse to the fall so it lands with a hawk's speed.

name: Peal Wristhitch
description: Read a crowd from above for the one man giving orders and mark him for the stone.

name: Lordly Cordleft
description: Ring a falling stone off the helm so that the skull inside hums and the footing fails.

name: Peltcrown
description: Drop a heavy slug from the full height of the perch so that it falls like a hammer.

name: Magma Singing
description: Cast a loose cloud of pebbles high so that it falls across a wide knot of foes.

name: Orbittriumph
description: Pick the tallest figure among the foes and drive a slug down through its guard.

name: Thunderclap Slingstone
description: Gather the whole manual into one dive of a stone that ends the fight from above.

name: Parity Slingtether
description: Wrap two stones in a single sheath of field so that they will be thrown as one.

name: Intrepid Slung
description: Swing a vast matched circle that carries both stones at one speed through every turn.

name: Pealpouch
description: Release both stones at the field's edge so that the sheath opens as they cross it.

name: Imperial Orbit
description: Steer the stones in flight by tugging the field's thread so they close on the mark.

name: Stately Releasecord
description: Spread the field before the body and turn a bolt aside as it strikes the sheath.

name: Prism Leadshot
description: Spin both stones in opposite senses so that together they bore into plate like a drill.

name: Fearless Cradle
description: Loose one stone and let the field echo it into a second that follows a breath behind.

name: Quenched Flingaway
description: Cross the pair's paths just before the mark so that each strikes from the other's side.

name: Slingcrown
description: Link pair after pair on one thread of field so that each follows the last through the same opening.

name: Vacuum Stonepelt
description: Send both stones through a full guard together as one tearing force of two bodies.

name: Resplendent Pelt
description: Release the whole pair in one vast sheathed cast that no lesser guard can turn.

name: Bloom Cordright
description: Warm the whole cord with the Core's steady heat until it hums against the palm.

name: Paritysling
description: Anchor the stance to the Core so the body sits as still as a hawk on a post.

name: Wristhitch Banner
description: Draw the whirl from the Core in a smooth flow like a river without a ripple.

name: Prismpelt
description: Count the Core's own pulse and let go on the fourth beat each time.

name: Peal Releasecord
description: Drive a pulse from the Core straight into the stone so it flies with a steady hum.

name: Pulsar Pouch
description: Bend the throw around a corner on a ribbon of Core qi that trails the stone.

name: Vigor Slingstone
description: Hold the Core's output level and calm across a whole long volley of throws.

name: Quenched Orbit
description: Strike one target with a pair of stones that carry the Core's shock in their weight.

name: Vacuum Cordleft
description: Drive a slug laced with Core qi through a shield and the arm behind it.

name: Magma Orbit
description: Roll a stream of Core-driven stones over the field in a long flowing sweep.

name: Haemalslung
description: Dive one stone from above while a second runs low along the ground to meet it at the foe.

name: Steel Flingaway
description: Pour the formed Core into one cast whose stone leaves the whole basin in its wake.

name: Hospitable Cordright
description: Take the stance on the oath's first breath and hold it through the whole cast.

name: Pealslung
description: Start the whirl in the open with no wall at the back and the whole sky overhead.

name: Pulsarorbit
description: Open the hand fully at the release as though handing the stone to the wind.

name: Radiance Cradle
description: Speak the oath on the pulse so that its last word carries the stone out.

name: Deluge Leadshot
description: Trim one pace along the plateau's edge to move the line of the throw clear of danger.

name: Deluge Fingerhitch
description: Whip the cord across the front and let the gust finish pushing a thrown blade away.

name: Splendid Pelt
description: Lob the stone along a taken bearing with a pulse that lifts it over a rise.

name: Unrivaled Slingtether
description: Throw a slug with the gust behind it into a thin line that pierces leather and mail.

name: Orchestral Stonepelt
description: Chain throws one to the next on the breath of the oath so that none are wasted.

name: Prismslung
description: Speak the whole oath through a winding and loose a stone that parts even a crosswind.

name: Bedrock Pouch
description: Swear every form of the school to the sky and loose one stone the wind carries home.

name: Benevolent Pouch
description: Take the bearing to the far point and fix it on a landmark at the horizon.

name: Squallpouch
description: Tilt the whirl's plane to follow the plateau's rim and keep the cord clear of rock.

name: Pouchdecree
description: Release on the fifth count so that the stone leaves exactly along the taken bearing.

name: Cordright Verdict
description: Hold the bearing against a shifting gust with a pulse that keeps the stone on line.

name: Revelation Fingerhitch
description: Work out how far the plateau's winds will push a stone and aim off by that much.

name: Noble Wristhitch
description: Loose at a foe climbing over the rim so that the stone meets him as he rises.

name: Singing Decree
description: Cast along a held bearing the whole breadth of the plateau and strike a far figure.

name: Orchestral Slung
description: Roll two stones down one bearing a breath apart so the second meets the first's dust.

name: Lordly Leadshot
description: Hold the bearing through a long winding and drive the stone across the whole plateau.

name: Matchless Releasecord
description: Fold all the school's bearings into one cast that reaches the end of the sworn line.

name: Vigorsling
description: Trim the footing on the rim's rough stone until the stance fits every gust.

name: Volition Cordleft
description: Wrap the cord once about the wrist so that a sudden gust cannot tear it free.

name: Slingedict
description: Whirl in a tight fast circle that the gale cannot bend out of its plane.

name: Orbitdecree
description: Let go the moment a gust parts so the stone slips through the gap.

name: Lordly Orbit
description: Lash the stone out on a pulse that snaps along the line of the gust.

name: Pealorbit
description: Skip the stone off the rim's face so that it rebounds up into a climber's reach.

name: Bedrock Slingstone
description: Lock the cord taut against the gale so it makes a stiff screen before the face.

name: Binding Pelt
description: Throw the cord's loop and let the gust snap it tight about a passing leg.

name: Thunderous Stonepelt
description: Hammer the rim with a steady rain of stones that the gale spreads over a wide ledge.

name: Slung Triumph
description: Roll a run of throws along the rim with each carried by the gust that freed the one before.

name: Prism Flingaway
description: Drive the stone through a full guard on the strongest gust of the rim.

name: Magnificent Singing
description: Make the gale itself the second hand of a single cast that no foe on the rim can answer.

name: Eclipse Slingtether
description: Take bearings on open ground using only the sun and the distant hills.

name: Paramount Singing
description: Draw the whirl wide on the plain with room to let the cord run its full length.

name: Pealpelt
description: Turn so that the gale is at the back and release with its push behind the stone.

name: Slungverdict
description: Combine a held bearing and a gust-timed pulse so the stone flies exactly where aimed.

name: Bedrock Fingerhitch
description: Slide across the open flank in a long low step the instant the stone is gone.

name: Slingvow
description: Spread the cord in the grass and snap it taut round the legs of a charging mount.

name: Steel Cradle
description: Aim off a galloping rider by the gale's push and let it carry the stone to him.

name: Orbitbanner
description: Pour stones along the enemy's front for so long that its line cannot move up or hold still.

name: Tenetcradle
description: Chain three throws each on its own bearing and each carried by its own gust.

name: Pulsarsling
description: Drive a stone clean through whatever barrier the foe has put up in the open.

name: Gallant Leadshot
description: Draw the whole school into a single cast that clears open ground of those who stand upon it.

name: Bloompouch
description: Charge the cord with field until it flutters in the wind like a living ribbon.

name: Thunderclap Wristhitch
description: Draw the gale into the whirl until the pouch circles as part of the wind itself.

name: Thunderclap Orbit
description: Release the stone from inside the field so the wind takes it at once.

name: Prism Slingtether
description: Send a pulse into the field so the gale carries stone and sheath together to the far mark.

name: Cradleverdict
description: Wrap a slug in a thin eddy of wind that drills it through a leather shield.

name: Deluge Releasecord
description: Flick the field's edge into a gust to turn an arrow wide of the body.

name: Pouchtriumph
description: Throw up the wind's face and let it carry the stone to a height before the fall.

name: Volition Slingstone
description: Ride three stones on one gust in a staggered row so that each strikes in turn.

name: Thunderclap Cradle
description: Draw the field into a thin spear about the stone and let the wind drive it through armour.

name: Valiant Pelt
description: Cast on the full body of the wind so that the stone strikes with the weight of a gale.

name: Slingmercy
description: Hold the oath in the Core and let its warmth run down the arm into the cord.

name: Bloom Cordleft
description: Sink the stance to the Core and stand like the plateau's own rock against the gale.

name: Storied Flingaway
description: Let the Core drive the whirl to the rise of the wind and ride it up.

name: Radiance Cordright
description: Open the hand on the Core's beat so the stone leaves with nothing held back.

name: Magnificent Releasecord
description: Pulse the Core's qi into the gust so it throws the stone far past the hand's reach.

name: Slungbanner
description: Bend the stone around a boulder with a trailing thread of Core qi.

name: Parity Cordright
description: Breathe with the Core and the wind alike so that the thrower's output stays level.

name: Unrivaled Slung
description: Throw a stone whose weight is made heavy by the Core and rings loud on a shield.

name: Wristhitch Crown
description: Pack a slug with Core qi and let the wind drive it through the first rank of shields.

name: Demolition Orbit
description: Roll Core-driven stones across the plateau in a wave that the wind spreads wide.

name: Unrivaled Stonepelt
description: Bring Core and gale down together on one foe in a single stroke.

name: Steelpouch
description: Seat the whole plateau oath in the Core and loose it in one cast that does not miss.
